## Tavily (Remote)

Tavily's hosted MCP server searches the web, extracts page content, maps and crawls websites, and performs research. Use it to gather source material without installing the local Tavily server.

### Setup

Create a Tavily account, then run `thv run tavily-remote --remote-auth` and complete the OAuth sign-in. The server advertises Client ID Metadata Documents and dynamic client registration, so ToolHive can identify itself without a pre-created OAuth application. Keep ToolHive's default callback port, 8666, when using its published client metadata; other callback ports can be rejected because they do not match the registered redirect URIs.

For API-key authentication, create a key in your Tavily account and run with `--remote-auth-bearer-token-file <TOKEN_FILE>` instead of OAuth; this sends `Authorization: Bearer <TAVILY_API_KEY>`. No additional headers are required. An optional `DEFAULT_PARAMETERS` header accepts a JSON object of defaults for tool requests. Usage consumes your Tavily account's credits and limits. See the [remote MCP guide](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/mcp) for authentication and supported tools.
